items.text: `src/infrastructure/health/proj-health.controller.ts` — `GET /api/proj/health` (or shared monolith health endpoint if already registered); uses `@nestjs/terminus` `HealthCheckService` + `PrismaHealthIndicator`; returns 200 `{ status: 'ok' }` or 503 on DB unavailability

`src/infrastructure/middleware/correlation-id.middleware.ts` — NestJS middleware: reads `X-Correlation-Id` from request or generates UUID v4; stores in `AsyncLocalStorage<{ correlationId }>`; sets response header `X-Correlation-Id`; applies to all routes in `ProjModule`
Logger configuration (if not already shared) — structured JSON logger with fields: `correlationId`, `port` (when `degraded:true`), `level` (`WARN` on degraded), `module: 'proj'`
Every response includes `X-Correlation-Id` header matching the request header (or a new UUID if absent)
When `ManuscriptSummaryPort` stub emits `degraded:true`, a `WARN` log entry contains `port=ManuscriptSummaryPort` and `correlationId` (verifiable via logger spy in integration test)
`pnpm build` exits 0 with health controller registered
